newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan, US to hold insurance talks on Nov 15-16 - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan, US to hold insurance talks on Nov 15-16 - MOF.

text.p: Japan and the United States plan to hold working-level talks on a bilateral insurance issue on November 15-16 in San Francisco, a Ministry of Finance (MOF) official said on Monday.

Eisuke Sakakibara, director-general of the Finance Ministry's International Finance Bureau, will meet Ira Shapiro of the U.S. Trade Representative's (USTR) Office on the dispute over how to open up Japan's giant insurance market.

On Wednesday, Finance Minister Wataru Kubo told reporters that minister-level insurance talks may take place during the meeting of Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum members, due to be held in the Philippines in late November.
Various international meetings will be held in Asia around that time, and Kubo added that acting USTR Charlene Barshefsky may be able to visit Tokyo when she attends such conferences.
